summary: Barrett declared in October 2024 he will "always stand with Israel" as "our nation's strongest ally," framing the conflict around Hamas terrorism. He also urged Michigan State University in a May letter, reported by The State News in November 2025, to adopt the IHRA working definition of antisemitism. Vote for Peace rated him Opposed in the general. These statements and the IHRA push mark him as a strong Israel defender.
